cases.name: no-match
cases.comment: registered secret does not occur in the input; nothing changes

cases.name: long-secret-masked-mid-token
cases.comment: len>=7 is masked unconditionally, even embedded with no boundaries

cases.name: short6-word-boundary-masked
cases.comment: len==6 is still short (4-6); delimited on both sides it is masked

cases.name: short6-not-boundary-survives
cases.comment: len==6 embedded mid-token is left untouched

cases.name: short4-word-boundary-masked
cases.comment: len==4 delimited by spaces on both sides is masked

cases.name: short5-word-boundary-punct-masked
cases.comment: len==5 delimited by space and punctuation is masked

cases.name: short4-not-boundary-survives
cases.comment: len==4 embedded mid-token is left untouched

cases.name: short5-not-boundary-survives
cases.comment: len==5 embedded mid-token is left untouched

cases.name: short4-string-start-masked
cases.comment: start-of-string counts as a boundary; space closes the right side

cases.name: short4-string-end-masked
cases.comment: end-of-string counts as a boundary; space opens the left side

cases.name: short5-single-boundary-survives
cases.comment: one boundary is not enough; string start but non-boundary (alphanumeric) right side

cases.name: short4-underscore-boundary-masked
cases.comment: underscore is non-alphanumeric, so str.isalnum treats it as a word boundary

cases.name: multi-span-two-distinct-long
cases.comment: two different long secrets in one value produce two masked spans with the surrounding text preserved between them

cases.name: multi-span-same-short-both-boundaries
cases.comment: the same short secret occurring twice, each at a word boundary, is masked at both positions

cases.name: multi-span-mixed-boundary-and-mid-token
cases.comment: the same short secret is masked where it sits at a boundary but survives where it is embedded mid-token, in the same value

cases.name: leftmost-longest-nested-secret
cases.comment: when a shorter secret is a substring of a longer registered secret, iter_long selects the longest match

cases.name: adjacent-secrets-merged
cases.comment: two long secrets directly abutting each other are redacted as one span (adjacent and overlapping spans merge into a single placeholder)

cases.name: case-sensitive-no-match
cases.comment: matching is case-sensitive; a differently-cased occurrence is not a secret

cases.name: short4-whole-input-masked
cases.comment: a short secret spanning the entire value has both string edges as boundaries, so it is masked

cases.name: short4-digit-adjacency-survives
cases.comment: digits are alphanumeric, so a short secret flanked by digits is not at a boundary and survives

cases.name: short4-newline-boundary-masked
cases.comment: newlines are non-alphanumeric, so they act as word boundaries just like spaces

cases.name: short-adjacent-to-masked-long-survives
cases.comment: a short secret whose neighbour is an alphanumeric of an adjacent masked long secret is not at a boundary and survives even though the long secret is masked

cases.name: short4-unicode-letter-adjacency-survives
cases.comment: accented Latin letters are alphanumeric to both str.isalnum and char.IsLetterOrDigit, so a short secret flanked by them is not at a boundary and survives

cases.name: numeric-long-masked-mid-token
cases.comment: a numeric-only secret with len>6 is a long secret and is masked unconditionally, even embedded mid-token

cases.name: numeric-short-word-boundary-masked
cases.comment: a numeric-only short secret (4-6) delimited on both sides is masked

cases.name: numeric-short-not-boundary-survives
cases.comment: a numeric-only short secret flanked by digits is not at a word boundary and survives

cases.name: long-secret-masked-in-full
cases.comment: a long secret is still masked even beyond 1024 characters

cases.name: overlap-long-secrets-merged-into-one-span
cases.comment: two long secrets overlap (the second starts inside the first): every character of both is redacted as one placeholder, nothing of the second leaks

cases.name: overlap-chain-of-three-merged
cases.comment: a chain of overlapping secrets collapses into a single placeholder (the number of secrets is not revealed)

cases.name: overlap-secret-fully-inside-another
cases.comment: a secret contained inside a longer secret adds nothing beyond the longer span

cases.name: overlap-same-secret-self-overlapping
cases.comment: overlapping occurrences of one repeated-character secret are redacted as one span covering the whole run

cases.name: repeat-secret-back-to-back-merged
cases.comment: a secret repeated back to back is one span (adjacent spans merge)

cases.name: overlap-short-inside-long-boundary-rejected
cases.comment: a short secret glued to the following characters is rejected by the boundary rule even though it overlaps a long secret that is masked; the two visible characters are not part of any registered secret occurrence that qualifies

cases.name: short-rejected-shorter-secret-at-same-start-qualifies
cases.comment: the longest short secret at a position fails the boundary rule but a shorter registered secret starting at the same position sits at a boundary and is masked

cases.name: short-rejected-shorter-secret-also-rejected
cases.comment: when every short secret at a position is glued to alphanumerics nothing is masked

cases.name: short-self-overlap-both-rejected
cases.comment: overlapping occurrences of a short secret inside a longer alphanumeric run are all rejected by the boundary rule

cases.name: anchor-shared-prefix-longest-wins
cases.comment: two secrets sharing their first 8 characters and start position: the longer one is masked when present

cases.name: anchor-shared-prefix-shorter-when-longer-absent
cases.comment: with the same two secrets, when only the shorter is present it is the one masked

cases.name: anchor-shared-prefix-same-length-differ-at-end
cases.comment: two secrets that share an 8 char prefix and length but differ in the last character: only the registered one present is masked

cases.name: anchor-prefix-near-miss-survives
cases.comment: text containing the first 8 characters of a secret but not the rest is not masked

cases.name: anchor-and-middle-match-tail-differs-survives
cases.comment: text matching a secret except for its final characters is not masked (the full comparison decides, not the prefix or middle)

cases.name: secret-shorter-than-anchor-long
cases.comment: a 7 character secret (shorter than the anchor, longer than the short limit) is masked anywhere

cases.name: secret-exactly-anchor-length
cases.comment: an 8 character secret is masked anywhere

cases.name: secret-anchor-plus-one
cases.comment: a 9 character secret is masked anywhere

cases.name: structured-secrets-same-header-only-registered-masked
cases.comment: PEM-like secrets share their first 8 characters and their footer; only the registered ones are masked, an unregistered key with the same header and footer is not
cases.input:
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA1AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA3AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA2AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----

cases.name: json-escaped-quote-form-masked
cases.comment: a secret containing a double quote is also masked in its JSON-escaped form

cases.name: json-escaped-backslash-form-masked
cases.comment: a secret containing a backslash is also masked in its JSON-escaped form

cases.name: json-escaped-control-char-form-masked
cases.comment: a secret containing a tab is also masked when the tab is JSON-escaped as \t

cases.name: json-non-ascii-escaped-form-masked
cases.comment: a non-ASCII secret is masked both as UTF-8 and in the \uXXXX form produced by ensure_ascii encoders

cases.name: json-double-escaped-form-of-escaped-secret
cases.comment: a secret that itself contains a JSON escape is masked in its own (double) escaped form; the single escaped text is the other secret

cases.name: json-form-no-escapes-unchanged
cases.comment: a secret without escapable characters has no extra form; its JSON appearance is the secret itself

cases.name: empty-input
cases.comment: an empty input is returned unchanged

cases.name: input-is-exactly-the-secret
cases.comment: an input consisting only of a long secret becomes only the placeholder

cases.name: many-occurrences-each-masked
cases.comment: every separated occurrence is masked with its own placeholder

cases.name: unicode-secret-masked-mid-token
cases.comment: a long non-ASCII secret is masked anywhere, including glued to other non-ASCII letters

cases.name: short-unicode-secret-boundary
cases.comment: a short non-ASCII secret follows the boundary rule using Unicode alphanumeric classification

cases.name: secret-with-regex-metacharacters
cases.comment: secrets are literal text: regex metacharacters have no special meaning

cases.name: json-escaped-newline-form-masked
cases.comment: a secret containing a newline is masked raw and with the newline JSON-escaped as \n

cases.name: json-astral-char-both-encodings-masked
cases.comment: a secret with a non-BMP character is masked as UTF-8 and as the \uXXXX surrogate pair an ensure_ascii encoder produces

cases.name: json-mixed-escapes-both-encodings-masked
cases.comment: a secret mixing a quote, a backslash, a non-ASCII letter and a newline is masked raw and in both JSON encodings

cases.name: json-document-held-in-a-string-value
cases.comment: a JSON document inside a value (a module stdout) holds the single-escaped form of the secret, which is masked

cases.name: long-secret-inside-longer-token-masked-truncated-lookalike-survives
cases.comment: a long secret is masked wherever it occurs, even inside a longer token; text that is only a truncated prefix of it is not

cases.name: registered-secret-masks-text-produced-earlier
cases.comment: forms are derived at registration, so the JSON encoding of a secret is masked regardless of when the text was produced (no per-text state)

cases.name: span-merge-gap-of-one-char-stays-separate
cases.comment: two secrets separated by a single character are two placeholders; only touching or overlapping spans merge

cases.name: span-merge-found-out-of-order
cases.comment: a short secret ending before a longer secret that started earlier is found first; merging must still yield the longer span

cases.name: probe-length-16-masked
cases.comment: secret lengths around the probe window (middle 8 chars) must verify: 16 chars

cases.name: probe-length-17-masked
cases.comment: secret lengths around the probe window (middle 8 chars) must verify: 17 chars

cases.name: probe-length-1024-non-repeating-masked
cases.comment: a 1024 char non-repeating secret verifies through its anchor and middle probe and is masked in full

cases.name: probe-prefix-matches-middle-differs-survives
cases.comment: text sharing the first 8 chars of a secret but differing in the middle is not masked
